_comment: Committed regression baseline (ADR-0004 decision 5, v0.5.0). This is the DETERMINISTIC stub-run aggregate for the 2-case echo golden slice below (echo-pass PASSES, echo-fail FAILS -> overall passRate 0.5). Because the STUB SUT + STUB judge path is fully deterministic, a baseline-equals-current run yields passRateDelta:0 and regressed:false everywhere — the reproducible CI anchor. The offline test driver (scripts/Test-EvalHarnessWorkflow.ps1) injects this object as body.baseline (with baselineSource:'fixture') alongside the SAME golden slice to assert the no-drift case, and mutates the pass-rates UPWARD to assert the regressed case (a deliberately-higher baseline -> negative passRateDelta -> regressed:true). NOT a hidden store: this explicit fixture is the CI baseline, so the delta never depends on execution history. Captured live from workflow IhmmthDFMKdDbgvp (v0.5.0) on 2026-05-30.
